meta.title: Fibre & FWA Activation, Migration, Home Move, Portability and Termination

lanes.name: Trigger / Queue
lanes.hint: Queue ticket intake per use case

lanes.name: Retail Agent
lanes.hint: Agent-driven journey steps across all use cases

lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: System of record for customer, order, tracking record

lanes.name: Order Mgmt, Network & Billing
lanes.hint: Order Management, network activation/deactivation, Billing, UIM, Notification

lanes.name: Portability Admin (NPAS)
lanes.hint: Number Portability Administration System, donor/recipient exchange

nodes.label: Queue Ticket Trigger
nodes.desc: One activation, migration, home move or portability process may be initiated per queue ticket transaction (BR-001). Integration: INT-01 (Queue Management System).

nodes.label: Initiate Customer Interaction
nodes.desc: A tracking record is created at journey initiation and owned by the initiating agent. Integration: INT-17 (CRM / Ticketing system, journey and tracking record creation). Status model: Tracking Record/New (record created automatically at journey initiation).

nodes.label: Journey Milestone Persistence
nodes.desc: The journey milestone is persisted as a draft order on every successful stage validation. Status model: Order/Draft (journey initiated, milestone saved, not yet submitted). Status model: Order/Cancelled (order withdrawn before completion; terminal). Status model: Tracking Record/In Progress (journey in progress against the assigned agent). Status model: Tracking Record/Cancelled (journey abandoned or order cancelled; terminal).

nodes.label: Scan Qatar Identity Document
nodes.desc: Front and back scanned, capturing name and date of birth on the front, document number on the back, with an optional liveliness check. Only a Qatar identity document is accepted; a passport is not permitted. P-08 (supported identity document types for fibre/FWA activation). Integration: INT-02 (Identity Capture Service).

nodes.label: Ministry of Interior Validation
nodes.desc: Customer information is retrieved from the Ministry of Interior using the Qatar identity document number. Integration: INT-03 (Ministry of Interior).

nodes.label: Identity Match Exact?
nodes.desc: First name, last name, document number and date of birth must match exactly between capture and government validation.

nodes.label: Journey Blocked — Identity Mismatch
nodes.desc: The journey does not proceed where identity comparison fails.

nodes.label: Display Verified Attributes
nodes.desc: Government-returned attributes are displayed for agent confirmation before the journey advances.

nodes.label: Lock Verified Attributes
nodes.desc: Identity attributes verified through government validation are rendered non-editable.

nodes.label: Customer Match Key Lookup
nodes.desc: Customer existence determined by nationality, identity document type and identity document number; an existing customer record is refreshed with the latest validation information.

nodes.label: Create Customer Account
nodes.desc: Account type, customer category and segment are mandatory. Default credit limit is set from the customer segment.

nodes.label: Agent Overridable Attributes
nodes.desc: Email address, language and alternate phone number may be overridden by the agent.

nodes.label: Email Verification
nodes.desc: The email address is captured and marked verified through the email verification service. Integration: INT-04 (Email Verification Service).

nodes.label: Contact Model
nodes.desc: A customer account may hold multiple contacts, each carrying an assigned role.

nodes.label: Capture Installation Address
nodes.desc: Captured by utility identifier or by zone, street, building, floor and flat number; floor and flat apply only to apartments.

nodes.label: Cascading Address Selection
nodes.desc: Address selection is filtered hierarchically: street list constrained by zone, building list by street.

nodes.label: Service Availability Search
nodes.desc: Point of presence searched by address, utility identifier or area; address auto-filled from ready for service data. FAR_001_RFS_04 (address auto-filled from ready for service data on search). Integration: INT-05 (Ready for Service Portal).

nodes.label: Service Type Display
nodes.desc: Service types available at the location — Fiber, FWA Indoor, FWA Outdoor — are displayed.

nodes.label: Customer Premises Equipment Detection
nodes.desc: Customer premises equipment and optical network terminal information displayed where a device is detected at the location.

nodes.label: Installation Address Lock
nodes.desc: Installation address updated after the ready for service check and is not editable; changing it requires recapture.

nodes.label: Proof of Address Upload
nodes.desc: A tenancy document is uploaded in PDF or Word format, maximum two megabytes. P-01 / P-03 (proof-of-address document maximum size and permitted format).

nodes.label: Connection Type Eligibility
nodes.desc: Journey proceeds only for a Qatar identity document holder taking a postpaid connection, with a distinct message per eligibility failure. FAR_001_ECC_01 (connection type eligibility gate, parent requirement of ECC_02/03). P-09 (supported connection type for this journey).

nodes.label: Eligibility Failure Message
nodes.desc: A distinct failure message is shown per eligibility failure reason.

nodes.label: Credit Check
nodes.desc: Existing customer credit check uses the enterprise data warehouse; new customer credit check uses the Qatar Credit Authority. Integration: INT-06 (Enterprise Data Warehouse) / INT-07 (Qatar Credit Authority).

nodes.label: Blacklisted / Over Threshold?
nodes.desc: A customer returned as blacklisted or in collections may not proceed; nor may one whose outstanding balance exceeds the configured fibre threshold (value: to be confirmed, P-17).

nodes.label: Privileged Credit Limit Override
nodes.desc: Only a privileged agent may modify the system-defaulted credit limit.

nodes.label: Capture Billing Profile
nodes.desc: Covers payment type, payment method, bill cycle, bill media and language. Postpaid only. BR-040 (single billing account per plan/MSISDN/fixed line number).

nodes.label: Billing Address
nodes.desc: The billing address is the customer address or a newly captured address.

nodes.label: Single Active Payment Profile
nodes.desc: A billing profile holds only one active payment profile; payment details are validated before the payment profile is created.

nodes.label: Billing Contacts
nodes.desc: Multiple billing contacts with exactly one primary; invoice delivered to the primary contact. Bill cycle defaulted per configured rule.

nodes.label: Eligible Base Plan Display
nodes.desc: Only fibre base plans eligible for the service type available at the address and the customer segment are presented.

nodes.label: IPTV Default Bundling
nodes.desc: IPTV bundled by default with the base plan; may be removed by the agent at customer request.

nodes.label: Mapped Add-On Selection
nodes.desc: Only an add-on pre-configured and mapped to the base plan may be added; no unmapped add-on is permitted.

nodes.label: Mapped Discount Display
nodes.desc: Only a discount mapped to the product is displayed; the section is empty where none applies.

nodes.label: Cart Price Recalculation
nodes.desc: Cart totals are recalculated on every add, amend or remove action.

nodes.label: Number Selection
nodes.desc: Fixed line number (free number category) for fibre; mobile number for FWA, star number not permitted for FWA. FAR_001_NUM_02 (mobile number selection for FWA) / FAR_001_NUM_03 (star number not permitted for FWA). Integration: INT-09 (UIM — number management).

nodes.label: SIM & CPE Selection
nodes.desc: Subscriber identity module and customer premises equipment scanned only for a fixed wireless access journey.

nodes.label: Number & Charges Review
nodes.desc: Number category and applicable charges displayed before the selection is confirmed.

nodes.label: Appointment Slot Retrieval
nodes.desc: Available appointment slots with lead time and technician availability fetched from the field workforce management system. Integration: INT-11 (Field Workforce Management).

nodes.label: Appointment Slot Selection
nodes.desc: Selected slot passed back to the field workforce management task. FAR_001_WFM_04 (selected slot and appointment information passed to the field workforce management task).

nodes.label: Appointment Applicability
nodes.desc: Appointment booking is skipped for FWA Indoor and mandatory for FWA Outdoor and fibre. P-06 / P-07 (FWA Indoor and FWA Outdoor appointment applicability parameters).

nodes.label: Appointment Notes & Collection Flags
nodes.desc: Additional notes and CAF/tenancy document collection flags captured and passed to the field workforce management task.

nodes.label: Workforce Task Execution
nodes.desc: Optical network terminal and set top box serial numbers, mesh device quantity, and wire length with one-time charge captured from the task. Status model: Order/Awaiting Workforce (order held pending field workforce management task closure).

nodes.label: Complimentary Mesh Device Rule
nodes.desc: The first two mesh devices are complimentary (P-05); further devices carry the configured monthly recurring charge.

nodes.label: Indoor & Outdoor Device Capture
nodes.desc: Both indoor and outdoor customer premises equipment serial numbers captured for a FWA Outdoor journey.

nodes.label: Workforce Task Closure
nodes.desc: The order proceeds only after field workforce management task closure with customer feedback is received.

nodes.label: Fault Ticket & Reschedule
nodes.desc: A reported installation issue creates a fault ticket, updates the task on closure, and allows the appointment to be rescheduled.

nodes.label: Initiate Cart Checkout
nodes.desc: Cart, customer, billing, number, resource and eligibility validations execute at checkout before payment. Status model: Order/Pending Payment (validations passed, awaiting payment).

nodes.label: Display Key Information
nodes.desc: Plan selected and lock-in period displayed before CAF submission, refreshed on any cart amendment.

nodes.label: Generate Contract Application Form
nodes.desc: Generated from the template selected by product type and connection type, using the configured matrix of agent role, channel, product type and connection type.

nodes.label: Capture Signature
nodes.desc: Customer signature captured through the digital form or touch screen, displayed within the online form.

nodes.label: Offline Signed Form Upload
nodes.desc: Signed form uploaded in PDF or JPG format, up to two megabytes. P-02 / P-04 (signed CAF document maximum size and permitted format).

nodes.label: Additional Documents & Activity Comments
nodes.desc: Additional supporting documents uploaded; activity comments captured by the agent are passed to the field workforce management task.

nodes.label: Upfront Payment Processing
nodes.desc: Upfront payment request sent to the point of sale payment system; payment status set from the response. Integration: INT-08 (Point of Sale Payment System).

nodes.label: Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: Fixed line number inventory depleted for fibre; SIM and equipment inventory depleted for FWA, on payment completion. Integration: INT-10 (UIM — SIM/equipment/address inventory).

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Order submitted once all sections are complete and payment is paid, routed to the order management system. FAR_001_ORD_02 (order routed to fulfilment on submission). Integration: INT-12 (Order Management). Status model: Order/Submitted (order submitted to the order management system).

nodes.label: Submission Notification
nodes.desc: Order submission notification sent to the primary contact mobile number and email address (trigger points, templates and recipients: to be confirmed). Integration: INT-14 (Notification Platform).

nodes.label: Network Activation — Fibre
nodes.desc: Triggered on field workforce management task completion for fibre; status updated in Siebel CRM. Status model: Order/In Fulfilment (provisioning, workforce and activation in progress); Order/Failed (fulfilment or activation failed; reprocesses to In Fulfilment or moves to Cancelled). Status model: Order/Activated (network activated, service is live).

nodes.label: Network Activation — FWA Indoor
nodes.desc: Proceeds on the planned activation date without a field workforce management task.

nodes.label: SIM Activation
nodes.desc: Subscriber identity module activated together with network activation for a FWA journey.

nodes.label: Billing Update
nodes.desc: Account, product, service and resource information with per-line prices, including additional devices, passed to the billing system after task closure. Integration: INT-13 (Billing System).

nodes.label: Additional Device Billing
nodes.desc: CPE captured at order capture billed for FWA Indoor; CPE captured during the task billed for fibre and FWA Outdoor.

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: Order completion notification sets order status to completed in Siebel CRM. Status model: Order/Completed (order completed and billing updated; terminal).

nodes.label: Tracking Record Resolved
nodes.desc: Tracking record set to resolved on order completion, with the order number recorded. Status model: Tracking Record/Resolved (order completed, order number recorded).

nodes.label: Feedback Survey Despatched
nodes.desc: Customer feedback survey despatched on tracking record closure. Terminal. Status model: Tracking Record/Closed (all updates complete, feedback survey triggered; terminal).

nodes.label: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
nodes.desc: A reusable pre-installed device eligible for instant activation is detected from the ready for service response.

nodes.label: Channel Constraint Check
nodes.desc: Instant activation is available only to field agents on a tablet device; physical device verification is not supported on a desktop-only agent. FAR_002_INS_07 (channel constraint check, exact match).

nodes.label: Device Serial Verification
nodes.desc: Agent verifies the detected device serial number against the physical device before instant activation proceeds; a mismatch is recorded and may lead to failure.

nodes.label: Instant or Normal Activation?
nodes.desc: Agent selects explicitly, defaulting to normal where instant is not selected.

nodes.label: Appointment Auto-Skip
nodes.desc: Appointment booking is auto-skipped for instant activation; the agent retains the flexibility to book on customer request.

nodes.label: Immediate Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission; completion target 30 minutes (P-21). Outcome is notified.

nodes.label: Instant Activation Failure Handling
nodes.desc: A non-working service following instant activation raises a support request and arranges a technician visit.

nodes.label: Migration Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Migration is permitted only from active FWA Indoor or FWA Outdoor services to Fibre.

nodes.label: Customer Verification
nodes.desc: Customer verification must be completed before migration order creation.

nodes.label: Fibre Availability Validation
nodes.desc: Migration can proceed only where Fibre service is RFS-ready at the installation address.

nodes.label: Existing Service Retrieval
nodes.desc: Existing FWA service details retrieved for the migration.

nodes.label: Migration Order Capture
nodes.desc: Lead ID, opportunity ID, language, alternate contact and enterprise-care flag are mandatory migration attributes.

nodes.label: Fibre Installation Appointment
nodes.desc: Mandatory for all migrations. Telephone-originated requests require CAF and tenancy collection flags.

nodes.label: Telesales Request Handling
nodes.desc: Migration requests raised via telesales are handled per the same governance.

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: FWA Outdoor migrations require separate outdoor device recovery.

nodes.label: Existing Service Continuity
nodes.desc: Existing FWA service remains active until Fibre activation succeeds.

nodes.label: Fibre Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Fibre activation cannot occur before successful installation closure.

nodes.label: Migration Failure Recovery
nodes.desc: Failed Fibre migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service.

nodes.label: SIM Deactivation
nodes.desc: FWA SIM deactivation occurs only after successful Fibre activation; connection and services terminated.

nodes.label: Resource Release
nodes.desc: FWA resources released only after successful migration completion.

nodes.label: Billing Migration Cutover
nodes.desc: Billing for Fibre begins on migration completion date; FWA billing ceases on the same date.

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Customers notified at request creation, appointment confirmation, migration completion and migration failure.

nodes.label: Migration Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal.

nodes.label: Home Move Request Created
nodes.desc: Created through the store queue or by a support agent, routed to the fibre fulfilment team queue.

nodes.label: New Installation Address Capture
nodes.desc: New installation address captured and its service availability checked for the new location. P-18 (home move appointment lead time).

nodes.label: Fixed Line Number Retention
nodes.desc: A new fixed line number is refused for a Home Move order — the existing number is retained.

nodes.label: Old Location Fibre Device Retention
nodes.desc: No uninstallation appointment is captured for a fibre-to-fibre home move; the device is retained at the old location.

nodes.label: Old Location Outdoor Uninstallation
nodes.desc: Uninstallation appointment for the FWA Outdoor device at the old location, for a move originating from FWA Outdoor.

nodes.label: Service Termination at Old Location
nodes.desc: All services at the old location terminated on the confirmed move date.

nodes.label: Inventory Release at Old Location
nodes.desc: Customer premises equipment and IP address at the old location released on the confirmed move date.

nodes.label: WFM Task Execution at New Location
Move Date Billing Update
nodes.desc: Billing triggered on the move date for new location activation and updated for old location termination.

nodes.label: FWA Equipment Carried by Customer
nodes.desc: FWA equipment carried by the customer to the new location and handed over at the store where the move is to a FWA area.

nodes.label: Home Move Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal.

nodes.label: Ported Number Capture
nodes.desc: Fixed line number being ported in is captured; new number selection is refused for a port in.

nodes.label: Portability Identifier at Appointment
nodes.desc: Portability identifier marked during appointment booking.

nodes.label: Portability Appointment Date
nodes.desc: Auto-set to Installation Date + 5 business days (excluding Friday and Saturday).

nodes.label: Portability Form Submission
nodes.desc: Portability form completed, signed by the customer and uploaded before the port in proceeds.

nodes.label: Portability Request Creation
nodes.desc: Portability request created and submitted to the number portability administration system. Integration: INT-15 (Number Portability Administration System).

nodes.label: Request Confirmation by Donor Provider
nodes.desc: Portability request validated and confirmed in the portability administration system by the donor service provider.

nodes.label: Appointment Date Reconfirmation
nodes.desc: Portability appointment date must be rescheduled based on the confirmed port-in date.

nodes.label: Ported Number Activation
nodes.desc: Ported number activated after portability completion and configured during the task; no temporary number is provided.

nodes.label: Port In Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal.

nodes.label: Port Out Request from NPAS
nodes.desc: A port out request from the number portability administration system creates a trouble ticket in Siebel CRM. Status model: Portability Ticket/Created (port out ticket created from the administration system request).

nodes.label: Queue Assignment
nodes.desc: Ticket auto-assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer started (2 hours, P-11). Status model: Portability Ticket/Validating (documents and mandatory checks in progress within the initial service level).

nodes.label: Document Validation
nodes.desc: Portability form and identity document validated; documents may be uploaded to the ticket.

nodes.label: Mandatory & Form Checks
nodes.desc: Form date within the allowed period (30 days, P-10); customer name, identity document number and service type match system records.

nodes.label: Outstanding Bill?
nodes.desc: A pending bill moves the request to conditionally accepted with a defined settlement window (24 hours, P-13). Status model: Portability Ticket/Conditionally Accepted (awaiting outstanding dues settlement within the window).

nodes.label: Service Level Extension
nodes.desc: A valid document set extends the service level timer to the final action period (24 hours, P-12).

nodes.label: Auto-Processing on Breach
nodes.desc: A request with no action within the service level is auto-processed per the configured rule (auto-accept vs auto-reject: to be confirmed, BR-176 Open). Status model: Portability Ticket/Suspended (request suspended where no action taken within the service level).

nodes.label: Status Communication to NPAS
nodes.desc: Every accept, reject and conditional acceptance action communicated to NPAS with the defined status code (rejection code list: to be supplied by VFQ). P-14 (port-out portability window) / P-20 (port-out escalation threshold). Status model: Portability Ticket/Accepted (request accepted and communicated to the administration system).

nodes.label: Termination Order Generation
nodes.desc: Termination order generated from the closed ticket with a non-editable wish date equal to the confirmed portability date. Status model: Portability Ticket/Termination Order Generated (termination order generated and linked, network deactivation scheduled; terminal).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Services deactivated on the confirmed portability date with a one-hour activation window towards the new provider (P-15).

nodes.label: Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory quarantined for the configured period (90 days, P-16); SIM deactivated and released for FWA.

nodes.label: Port Out Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal.

nodes.label: Port Out Rejected
nodes.desc: Terminal. Status model: Portability Ticket/Rejected (request rejected with a reason communicated to the administration system; terminal).

nodes.label: Termination Request Initiated
nodes.desc: Initiated from Customer 360 or a linked disconnection ticket by an authorised Retail or Retention user. Status model: Termination Request/Created (termination request captured from Customer 360 or disconnection ticket).

nodes.label: Customer & Service Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Termination may proceed only for an active eligible Fibre/FWA service with no conflicting open order or restricted block.

nodes.label: Retention Handling
nodes.desc: A retention outcome is mandatory before termination order creation where the process is routed through Retention. Status model: Termination Request/Under Retention (retention handling in progress). Status model: Termination Request/Cancelled (request cancelled before completion; terminal).

nodes.label: Retained — Termination Averted
nodes.desc: Terminal. Status model: Termination Request/Retained (customer accepts retention outcome, does not proceed with termination; terminal).

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues Validation
nodes.desc: Outstanding dues handling must follow the configured VFQ settlement rule before termination completion. Status model: Termination Request/Validation Failed (one or more mandatory validations failed; returns to Under Retention or moves to Cancelled).

nodes.label: Penalty Charge Display
nodes.desc: Early termination or lock-in penalty calculated and shown where the service is within the applicable minimum subscription period. Plan lock-in is 3 months per the CAF.

nodes.label: Consent & Reason Capture
nodes.desc: Customer consent, termination reason and requested termination date are mandatory before submission.

nodes.label: Equipment Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: WFM recovery appointment mandatory for configured service/device scenarios, skipped where recovery is not required.

nodes.label: Termination Order Capture
nodes.desc: Termination order created only after validations, consent and recovery rules are satisfied. Status model: Termination Request/Validated for Termination (eligibility, outstanding, penalty and consent validations completed).

nodes.label: Termination Order Submission
nodes.desc: Status model: Termination Request/Termination Order Submitted (termination order created and sent to Order Management).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Occurs on the confirmed termination date; outcome returned to CRM. Status model: Termination Request/In Deactivation (network/service deactivation in progress); Termination Request/Failed (termination failed during order, deactivation, billing or inventory step).

nodes.label: Final Billing Closure
nodes.desc: Posted after termination, including outstanding, penalty, credit/refund and closure details where applicable.

nodes.label: Resource Release / Quarantine
nodes.desc: Service resources released, recovered or quarantined according to resource type and configured rules. FIB_TER_RTL_007_13 (termination inventory quarantine).

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Customer notifications triggered at configured termination milestones.

nodes.label: Termination Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal. Status model: Termination Request/Completed (service terminated, billing/inventory closure completed; terminal).

nodes.label: Site & Building Data Ingestion
nodes.desc: Site and building data from the geographic information system ingested into the inventory management system, the master for building and connectivity data.

nodes.label: Go-To-Market File Generation
nodes.desc: The go-to-market file is generated from the inventory management system as a full extract.

nodes.label: Pickup & Transformation
nodes.desc: Go-to-market file picked up through the mediation layer and transformed into the format required by each downstream system.

nodes.label: Data Distribution
nodes.desc: Distributed to the inventory management system, ready for service portal, Siebel CRM and the analytics data warehouse — IMS receives a full extract, CRM a delta. Integration: INT-16 (GIS / IMS / RPA mediation).

nodes.label: Vodafone Identifier Generation & Mapping
nodes.desc: Operator identifier generated separately and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships.

nodes.label: Ready for Service Status Update
nodes.desc: A building is marked ready for service once ready for provisioning, with its service level category recorded.

nodes.label: RFS Portal Search
nodes.desc: Ready for service portal searchable by address, utility identifier or area.

nodes.label: Recommendation Integration
nodes.desc: Offer recommendations from the big data system received into the ready for service portal.

nodes.label: Lead Creation from Portal
nodes.desc: A lead is created in Siebel CRM from the portal using the mobile number.

nodes.label: Continuous RFS Update
nodes.desc: Ready for service data updated by subsequent go-to-market file loads and by manual business updates. P-19 (RFS data refresh frequency).

connectivity.Purpose: Queue ticket intake and home move request routing
connectivity.Operation: Create and consume the queue ticket, route the home move request
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Allow the agent to proceed and record the degradation
connectivity.Status: Open. Interface specification reused from Mobile Activation

connectivity.Purpose: Qatar identity document scanning and extraction
connectivity.Operation: Scan the identity document and extract attributes
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Permit manual capture of the identity attributes

connectivity.Operation: Validate identity and return demographic attributes
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Draft the order and validate at submission
Capture the email address as unverified

connectivity.Operation: Search point of presence, return service type and device detection
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Block feasibility and raise an agent message
connectivity.Status: Open. Interface specification not provided in version 1.3

connectivity.Operation: Return existing customer credit status and outstanding balance
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Block progression and raise an agent message
Block progression and raise an agent message

connectivity.Operation: Take payment, issue receipt and deplete number, subscriber identity module and equipment inventory
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Hold the order and return the agent to the payment summary

connectivity.Operation: Reserve and manage the fixed line and mobile number
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Block number selection and raise an agent message

connectivity.Operation: Manage subscriber identity module, equipment and internet protocol address inventory
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Block resource allocation and raise an agent message

connectivity.Operation: Book the appointment, execute the task, capture devices and close with feedback
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Hold the order pending task closure and raise an alert
connectivity.Status: Open. Interface specification not provided in version 1.3

connectivity.Operation: Orchestrate fulfilment, trigger network activation/deactivation and return the outcome
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Set the order to failed and expose the failure reason

connectivity.Operation: Post account, product, service and resource information with prices
Despatch submission and completion notifications and the feedback survey
Submit, confirm and communicate portability requests and receive port out requests
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Hold the ticket and escalate on service level breach
connectivity.Status: Open. Status and rejection code alignment to be confirmed

connectivity.Protocol: File transfer through the mediation layer
connectivity.Operation: Ingest, transform and distribute the go to market building data
connectivity.Fallback Behaviour: Retain the last good load and raise an operational alert
connectivity.Status: Open. Frequency and delta logic to be confirmed
